provenance: Independent pressure scenario. At traffic-load=2, native CBR offers UE2=175 and UE6=137 bytes per 0.5ms slot. Fourfold peak at 25% duty preserves these ACTUAL integer byte means over every 80ms cycle. Packet caps match native actual CBR arrival-chunk sizes, so each ON arrival creates four native-sized packets, preserving cycle packet counts and payload sizes as well as bytes. No extra burst bytes. Radio, motion, deadlines and non-URLLC arrivals are unchanged.
